posts.t: 9 goals on 17 shots this season for Artturi Lehkonen. That goal went off a Lightning player's skate. Hockey gods on his side early on.

Artturi Lehkonen has 6 goals in 7.4 games, on pace for around 61 goals.

Given the rising salary cap, good timing for him to start hot. Maybe not so much for the Avs.
